The '''Kylan-15 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]].

It was most notably used by the military unit [[Churhee's Riflemen]]. The Riflemen used a modified version of the Kylan-15 created by their leader [[Vlaydm Churhee]]. The modifications included a [[Stock/Legends|collapsible stock]], an advanced sniping scope, and a silencer.
